background_image_description: A minimalist pattern of evenly spaced vertical stripes in soft gray and off-white, with a subtle textured paper look. The composition is uniform and monochrome, creating a clean, calm aesthetic.

nodes.asset_description: A minimalist background of soft vertical stripes in pale gray and white, with a faint central glow and paper-like texture. The evenly spaced bands create a clean, symmetrical composition that gently fades toward the edges.

A blue, sketch-style illustration of a lobster with raised claws sits centered inside an oval frame with a dotted border. The monochrome design on an off-white background gives it a vintage, nautical logo feel.
